newsitem.title: USA: Polk Audio reactivates repurchase program.
newsitem.headline: Polk Audio reactivates repurchase program.

text.p: Polk Audio Inc said it is reactivating its share repurchase program, and will buy back up to 400,000 shares of stock.
The company bought 4,777 shares in 1994 but did not purchase any shares during 1995 or 1996.

Polk said it believes that at current prices its shares are valued modestly relative to the underlying assets and income and moreover that reductions in the number of shares could enhance per share results going forward.

Polk said it expects to enter into a definitive licensing agreement within the next sixty days for a U.S. based computer manufacturer to use the registered trademark "Polk Audio" and certain patented technologies on loudspeakers to be sold with multimedia computer systems starting early summer 1997.

Polk said however than negotiations with the licensee have not been finalized, no written agreements have yet been consummated, and no assurance can be given that such a transaction will actually materialize.
